results.name: Armed-state farming
results.invariant: median_terminal_sleep <= 24 (v3.9.1-C median ~22, +2 for two-phase walk; >24 indicates farming)

results.name: Temple collision (zero-distance walk)
results.invariant: median_terminal_sleep >= 20 (v3.9.1-C ~20, +0 for collision = 20; <20 indicates common collisions)

results.name: Loss while armed (Front during walk)
results.invariant: losses == 0 in runs where win_armed: true (no loss while armed)

results.name: Do-nothing regression
results.invariant: median_terminal_sleep == 24 and losses == 8 (do-nothing baseline unchanged from v3.9.1-C)

results.name: Self-burn regression
results.invariant: median_selfburns == 0 (same-pole immunity unchanged from v3.9.1-C)

results.name: Campaign regression (Hope)
results.invariant: median_terminal_sleep <= 24 and wins >= 19 (Hope campaign within ±2 sleeps of v3.9.1-C + walk cost)

results.name: Campaign regression (Fear)
results.invariant: wins >= 14 (Fear campaign within expected asymmetry, allowing 2-loss variance)
